checks: S1 every model uses all 103 events once
S1 outer folds identical to an independent StratifiedKFold(seed=42)
S1 reported BA/LL/AUC recomputed exactly from saved OOF predictions
S1 independent LR CV reproduces all saved LR OOF probabilities (both objectives)
S1 log-loss estimands use separately tuned fits
S1 [logreg] Holm adjustments recomputed exactly (BA and LL families separately)
S1 [hgbt] Holm adjustments recomputed exactly (BA and LL families separately)
S1 confirmatory point differences recomputed (BA, AUC exact; LL within clipping-convention tolerance 1e-5)
S1 paired CIs agree with an independent bootstrap (4000 resamples, other seed) within 0.02
S1 LR tuning uses no held-out-fold labels (label permutation in each outer fold leaves its C and predictions unchanged)
S1 HGBT tuning uses no held-out-fold labels (fold 0 permutation)
Null: degree Gini and density identical to observed in every realization
Null: M2 real and M2-null BA reproduced by independent LR CV
Null: mixing plateau (unchanged-edge fraction stable from 5 to 20 swaps/edge, within 0.02)
S2 single-view and ensemble BA / log loss recomputed exactly from saved view predictions
S2 each event has exactly 10 single-view predictions per condition
S2 all contrast point estimates recomputed exactly (BA and log loss)
S2 common and budget-specific cohorts coincide at K=1000 and give identical results
S2 primary contrast directions agree between budget-specific and common cohorts (K=250, 500)
Mechanism: closed-form E[N_K] matches Monte Carlo (400 draws, 3 events, K=250)
Mechanism: variance decomposition computed (interpretation reported separately)

superseded_run_final._note: SUPERSEDED: pre-correction run, kept for the correction history only; not a current result

audit._note: Generated by src/export_audit_results.py from stored audit and pipeline outputs. Do not edit by hand.

study1_20_partitions._note: Outer partitions with seeds 42 and 1-19 on the same 103 events; out-of-fold predictions averaged over partitions, then an event-level paired bootstrap (2,000 resamples). Seeds 42 and 1-9 reproduce the pipeline's stored repeated splits (max |diff| < 1e-14). Unadjusted p unless p_LL_holm is given; p_LL_holm is over the audit's 7-contrast family listed in holm_family.

text_retention._note: Raw-archive recomputation. A text is usable if it is a non-null string that is non-empty after cleaning.

edge_limited_token_std._note: Post hoc. Models: A = N_K; B = N_K + token-count dispersion; C = N_K + six structural features; D = C + token-count dispersion. KK = trained and evaluated on single K-edge views; FF = full graphs of the same events. Budget-specific cohorts, outer partition 42, ten sampling seeds, event-level paired bootstrap (1,000 resamples), Holm over the six dispersion contrasts (B - A and D - C at three budgets; p_*_holm_family6), with the audit's three-budget values kept as p_*_holm_across_K. A and C equal the pipeline's stored Study 2 values (checked).

study2_contrasts_holm._note: Estimates, intervals and bootstrap p-values are the pipeline's (1,000 resamples). p_holm_across_K adjusts each contrast and metric across K = 250, 500, 1000; it is computed here from the stored p-values. KK_minus_FF_combined has no stored p-value, so it has no adjusted value.
